description: PostgreSQL 18 range/multirange cross-type operators, multirange set arithmetic and ordering, and range aggregate overloads
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_range_set_rows (id int PRIMARY KEY, bucket text NOT NULL, i4 int4range, i4m int4multirange, i8 int8range, nr numrange, dr daterange, tr tsrange, tzr tstzrange);

SELECT range_agg(i4), range_intersect_agg(i4), range_agg(i4m), range_intersect_agg(i4m), range_agg(i8), range_intersect_agg(i8), range_agg(nr), range_intersect_agg(nr), range_agg(dr), range_intersect_agg(dr), range_agg(tr), range_intersect_agg(tr), range_agg(tzr), range_intersect_agg(tzr) FROM type_matrix_range_set_rows;
SELECT pg_typeof(range_agg(i4)), pg_typeof(range_intersect_agg(i4)), pg_typeof(range_agg(i4m)), pg_typeof(range_intersect_agg(i4m)) FROM type_matrix_range_set_rows;
SELECT bucket, range_agg(i4), range_intersect_agg(i4), range_agg(i4m), range_intersect_agg(i4m) FROM type_matrix_range_set_rows GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket;
SELECT range_agg(i4), range_intersect_agg(i4), range_agg(i4m), range_intersect_agg(i4m) FROM type_matrix_range_set_rows WHERE id < 0;
SELECT range_agg(i4) FILTER (WHERE id = 1), range_intersect_agg(i4) FILTER (WHERE id = 2) FROM type_matrix_range_set_rows;
SELECT range_agg(DISTINCT i4), range_intersect_agg(DISTINCT i4m) FROM type_matrix_range_set_rows;
